decisions.statement: A locked category rule is refused an update, a move or a deletion unless that call says `--force`.
The id is said as a word rather than at its flag.
A call saying no id is refused, asking for the id by its placeholder.
A `--` makes the word after it the id rather than a flag this takes none of.
Words this takes none of are all named in one refusal.
Locking a category rule already locked changes nothing.
An id no category rule carries refuses the call.

definition: the command locking a category rule named by its id
